title: Lumis — AI Automation Agency
description: A landing page for an agency that builds and runs custom AI agents. The hero is a live workflow canvas: pick a job, watch the agent steps assemble, approve the human step, and drag the nodes while the wires follow. Includes a review-queue process story, case studies, an ROI calculator and a call booking picker.
features: Self-building workflow with draggable nodes, live wires and a human approval step
Swipeable review queue for drafted agent actions
ROI calculator with elastic stepper and ruler picker
Day and time slot booking with a progress button
Hydration-safe, reduced-motion aware, no remote assets
